name: Ain
overview: The name Ain appears in Scripture as both a city associated with the tribe of Simeon, also called Ashan and possibly identical with En-Rimmon, and as a significant landmark marking the northern boundary of the land of Palestine. The city of Ain is listed among other towns in the tribal allotments (Joshua 15:32; 19:7) and in the cities given to the Levites (Joshua 21:16). Additionally, Numbers 34:11 references Ain as a boundary point near Riblah, emphasizing its geographical importance in defining the Promised Land's extent.
